07 / Common questions

Clear answers,
from the start.

What organisations often want to understand before discussing a system.

What kinds of organisations does Quantum work with?

Quantum’s systems are relevant to businesses, SMEs, institutions, schools, hospitals and clinics in Bahrain and the wider GCC.

Can Quantum provide more than one operational system?

Yes. Quantum’s portfolio covers software development, AI, ERP and accounting, HR, hospital, school and sales automation needs under one provider.

Is the software cloud-based?

Quantum is cloud-first, making business systems easier to access and manage across teams and locations.

Can you build custom software?

Yes. Quantum provides custom software and related development services. The right scope is defined around the organisation’s actual requirements.
